enable_mixed_precision: enable mixed precision mode by setting a target dtype for tensor casting
disable_mixed_precision: disable mixed precision training and reset to default precision
decorate_function_with_modes: decorate a function with mixed precision modes to cast inputs and outputs to float16
use_mixed_precision_scope: use a context manager scope to temporarily set mixed precision dtype for a code block
cast_function_arguments: cast function arguments and return values to a specified floating point dtype
